text: {"lessons":["I let Stock C fall to a 54.7% loss before selling; I should set clear risk limits and reassess a position before losses become that large.","Selling winners quickly but holding losing positions can skew my portfolio; I should evaluate every stock by its future prospects, not its purchase price or whether I can lock in a gain.","Frequent trading and buying back into positions do not guarantee better results; I should make deliberate decisions based on the whole portfolio and avoid reacting to short-term moves."]}
